who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane P (the lazy parent, run.md D124)
what: The lazy parent's maker and roots read the program's crates through make_one.rs `NamesRecords` (a `Records` over each crate's `CrateScope` record), and the only code in the tree that makes those records is body_types.rs `checker`, private to `blaze check`'s body job, built from a `TypesJob` owner. `blaze run` has no path to them, so the parent's names closure is an owed typed error; bstd `Cx::span` also takes only a static name, so a first call's span cannot name the function.
cost: the first call of a program with no start list under today's certificate stops by name until the records are made one way for both commands
cause: the records are made inside one command's job instead of one shared constructor
fix: move `checker`'s StoreLoad/Log/Records construction into one function both `blaze check` and `blaze run` call; give bstd a span with a dynamic field
